battery.artifact: run_ladder_seed per seed, contamination artifact, rate artifact.k3Rate
battery.clean: run_ladder_seed per seed, conditions as above, rate 0
battery.order: clean seeds ascending, then artifact seeds ascending

tests.K3a: acc(TGL) > acc(TGL-NC) on artifact bags at rate 0.4

K3-ablation.tables: two declared tables, one per ladder

room.definition: median over seeds of d_start(own partner) / median same-class source-bag spread, source bags through the frozen phase-1 encoder, target bags through the target encoder
room.readOn: the whole seed set; a verdict 'not supported' only where the gate holds

measurements.partnerKernelRank: fraction of target train bags whose own partner is the kappa^B-nearest same-class source train bag, at the start of phase 2 (encoder after phase 1, before any target update)
measurements.partnerKernelRankEnd: the same fraction at the end of phase 2
measurements.piEntropyRatio: per arm (TGL, TL, TG): mean over phase-2 steps and the step's target bags of H(pi_{ji|c}) / log(k), c the bag's pseudo-label, pi_{ji|c} Eq. (34) over the step's k same-class source bags, from the local term's own kernel pairs
measurements.routingErrorRate: fraction of target train bags whose argmax pseudo-label under the phase-1 head and encoder (start of phase 2) is wrong
measurements.s: partner separation within class (partner.separationWithin), target test role

purpose: K2 and K3 re-read with pre-registered gating measurements (odd/tasks/pipeline-phase-review.md L115, L122): the ladder only, clean and artifact material, with pi entropy, kernel-space partner rank and routing error rate measured per arm.
rule: A test whose gate holds is supported iff its Holm-adjusted p < alpha (K3a: raw p), else not supported. A test whose gate fails is reported 'inconclusive (mechanism had no room)', never 'not supported'. K2a and K3a carry no gate.
run: run 6: K2 push and K3 ladder under a subject-specific residual (L129-L131)
statistic: Wilcoxon signed-rank, one-sided greater, paired over the 30 seeds
test: Wilcoxon signed-rank, one-sided greater, zero_method=wilcox; rank-biserial; Hodges-Lehmann with Wilcoxon 95% CI
